theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Match Your Goals to Your Investment Timeline
body: Different life goals need different time horizons. Align your investment approach with when you'll need the money.
caption: Education, retirement, home, wedding—each goal deserves its own strategy. Starting early gives your investments time to work. #GoalBasedInvesting #WealthBuilding #InvestSmart #LongTermThinking #MoneyMatters
